recommendedBy: session agent, from a consuming timeline page's findings, in the order that page needs them

items.why: The whole-run view cuts off its last mark; every positioned consumer meets it.
One option retires a page's reach into the component's class names.
Bands and gaps retire a measured gradient and the empty lanes standing in for gaps.
A silent fallback misaligned a page; a warning is cheap.
Padding on the scroller misplaces the overview's zero.
A preset-only page needs to turn the wheel zoom off.
A click should not ring the listbox.
Waiting needs a hatch, and a failed step needs its marker in the error colour.
The cross should fit the column it marks.
